description: Java source code for the StandardClojureEngine class, which enables OFBiz services written in Clojure by loading Clojure namespaces and invoking functions.

classes.name: StandardClojureEngine
classes.description: A class that extends GenericAsyncEngine to provide a Clojure-based service engine for OFBiz, capable of loading Clojure namespaces and invoking functions as services.

methods.name: callClojure
methods.description: Loads a Clojure namespace and calls a specified function within it, passing in the dispatch context and service parameters.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Overrides to run a service synchronously, ignoring the result.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously and returns the result as a Map, throwing an exception if the result is not a Map.

methods.name: serviceInvoker
methods.description: Handles the invocation of the Clojure service, including loading the namespace, calling the function, and handling exceptions.
